title: oxytropis campestris
intro: Oxytropis campestris, commonly known as the field locoweed, is a type of perennial legume plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory conditions such as asthma. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and promote the clearance of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of Oxytropis campestris include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
